findings: Unedited Wix restaurant template: footer reads "(c) 2023 by The Pizza Shop. Proudly created with Wix.com".
Menu page still shows Wix placeholder text ("I'm a paragraph. Click here to add your own text...").
A blank page called "New Page" (/blank) sits in the main navigation, plus a second menu tab named "My New Menu".
Homepage "Our Story" and "Passion for Pizza" headings have no actual story text.
Every image on the site is Wix stock photography; none show Upper Crust's food or building.
"Reservations" and "Private Events" sections have no details.
Hours block is misaligned, the split Wed-Thu shifts are hard to read, there is no address in the header and no map or directions; typo "Tomatos".
Only calls to action are a mailing-list signup and the Slice link.
questions: Are the hours still Mon closed, Tue 4-8, Wed-Thu 12-2 and 4-8, Fri-Sat 12-9, Sun 12-8 (the site lists them this way)? Do they change seasonally?
Do you deliver? The current site does not say. What zones, fees and minimums?

Is there a story to tell (who opened it, when, who runs it)? Items like Griffin's Choice, Sophie's Southern Pizza and Miller's Chicken Philly sound like family or staff names; we did not invent any story.
What is the price of Little's Penne Marinara and Meatballs? It is blank on the current menu.
Is the Daily Lunch Combo offered every day, and during which hours?
Cheese and pepperoni slice listings read "add a second slice for 5.50" / "5.75"; is that the price for two slices? A stray $7.95 appears under Mozzarella Sticks; what is it for?
Do you take reservations or host private parties? Both headings exist with no details. What should the site say?
Is there an email address and a Facebook page to list? None found.
Please confirm the Instagram photos are yours to reuse, and send better photos of the shop and food if you have them.
